user.title: Dynamic energy prices
user.description: Enter the components of your dynamic Vattenfall contract. All amounts are excluding VAT. The all-in price is (market price + surcharge + energy tax) × (1 + VAT). The energy tax can be determined automatically from the price source.

data_description.electricity_surcharge: Supplier surcharge per kWh, excluding VAT.
data_description.gas_surcharge: Supplier surcharge per m³, excluding VAT.
data_description.energy_tax_auto: Use the energy tax supplied by the price source (EnergyZero: all-in price minus market price). The manual values below are used as fallback.
data_description.electricity_energy_tax: Energy tax per kWh, excluding VAT. Required when automatic is off; otherwise optional fallback.
data_description.gas_energy_tax: Energy tax per m³, excluding VAT. Required when automatic is off; otherwise optional fallback.
data_description.vat_percentage: VAT percentage applied to the total.

error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve prices from the price source. Try again later.
error.energy_tax_required: Enter the energy tax for electricity and gas, or enable automatic energy tax.
error.energy_tax_unavailable: The price source does not provide the energy tax. Enter it manually.
